Nodular fasciitis: The patient's presentation of a slowly enlarging, painless mass in the right hypothenar eminence, along with histological findings of a multi-nodular, well-circumscribed uniform spindle cell lesion with varying cellularity and fibrosis, and immunohistochemistry showing focal positivity for smooth muscle actin (SMA), is consistent with nodular fasciitis.
Palmar fibromatosis: The location of the mass in the hypothenar eminence and the histological findings of collagenous fibrous tissue with minimal mitotic activity and myofibroblastic differentiation are also consistent with palmar fibromatosis.
